primary_anchor_zh: 圆角橙色机身和宽阔深色扬声器面板
story_reason_zh: 收音机被取去检查电池，随后放回橱柜

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 大型复古收音机在中世纪风格客厅的低橱柜上，调谐窗保持柔和发光。
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 圆角橙色机身和宽阔深色扬声器面板占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 收藏者缓慢抱起收音机并从侧门搬出画面；随后呈现空低橱柜和后方木饰墙。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 收藏者缓慢抱起收音机并从侧门搬出画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 空低橱柜和后方木饰墙

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 收藏者缓慢将收音机搬回画面并放回低橱柜
shot_design.main_action_zh: 收藏者缓慢将收音机搬回画面并放回低橱柜
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新清楚呈现圆角橙色机身和宽阔深色扬声器面板，物件占据足够画面面积。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed medium shot frames a large rounded orange radio with a broad dark speaker panel on a low cabinet in a mid-century living room. Its tuning window glows softly. The orange body stands boldly against the dark wood.

A fixed medium shot shows a large rounded orange radio with a broad dark speaker panel on a low cabinet in a mid-century living room. A collector slowly lifts the radio from the cabinet and carries it through a side doorway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty low cabinet and the wood-paneled wall behind it. Light through the blinds shifts gently.

A fixed medium shot holds on the empty low cabinet and the wood-paneled wall behind it. A collector slowly carries the large rounded orange radio with a broad dark speaker panel back into frame and places it on a low cabinet in a mid-century living room.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 收藏者缓慢抱起收音机并从侧门搬出画面
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 空低橱柜和后方木饰墙
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 收藏者缓慢将收音机搬回画面并放回低橱柜
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
